name: responsive-dialog
title: Responsive Dialog
description: One dialog that changes shape with the screen: a centred modal with a short form and Save button on desktop, and a bottom drawer on narrow screens, driven by the same set of parts.
use: The same form must be a dialog on desktop but a thumb-friendly bottom sheet on phones without writing two versions.
avoid: Screen width alone decides the shell on the client, so server rendering or odd viewports can pick the wrong one.
a11y: Radix and Vaul give a focus trap, Escape to close and labelled fields, but the clip never shows the mobile drawer. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: On a near-black page a small outlined trigger button sits alone. Clicked, a rounded dark-grey panel appears in the middle with a title, a close X, two labelled text fields and a white Save changes button in a footer.
behaves: Clicking the trigger dims the page and pops the centred panel, with the cursor landing in the Name field. The X closes it and focus returns to the button; below the breakpoint the same parts render as a bottom drawer instead.
customise: Breakpoint width, open state and defaultOpen are props; colours and panel styling come from the dialog and drawer parts you import, and the form is yours to write.
weight: light: Renders one dialog or drawer; the cost is the imported Radix and Vaul primitives.
